newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech gets 2.2 bln ATS Venezuelan order.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech gets 2.2 bln ATS Venezuelan order.

text.p: VAI, a unit of Austria's VA Technologie, said on Friday it had received an order worth 2.2 billion schillings to set up a new Finmet fine ore reduction plant for Venezuela's Orinoco Iron.
Orinoco Iron is a unit of leading Venezuelan steel maker Sivensa.
VA Technologie said the new plant, with a capacity of about two million tons of hot briquetted iron per year, would be constructed in the city of Puerto Ordaz at the river Orinoco in Venezuela.
It added the start of production was scheduled for late 1999. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
